verdict.rationale: The evidence suggests Bland has some built-in call analytics: the MCP server can 'query analytics', there are historical call logs, and Evals use LLM judges to grade call quality on chosen dimensions. Nothing in the pack describes a visual dashboard or names success rates, durations, outcomes or sentiment metrics. Post-call webhooks point toward a build-your-own path. Missing for 10: documented analytics dashboard UI, explicit success-rate/duration/outcome/sentiment metrics, independent or hands-on corroboration.
